name: Feeds HTTP OAuth Fetcher
description: Adds an OAuth 2.0-enabled HTTP fetcher plugin to Feeds 3.x that obtains an access token (client_credentials or password grant) and sends it as an Authorization header when downloading a feed; credentials are selected as Key entities.
project_description: Feeds HTTP OAuth Fetcher provides an OAuth 2.0-enabled HTTP fetcher plugin for the Feeds module (Feeds 3.x). It adds a single Feeds fetcher, "Download from url (OAuth 2.0)" (plugin id http_oauth), that extends Feeds' core HttpFetcher. Before downloading the feed source, the fetcher requests an OAuth 2.0 access token from a per-feed access token URL and then sends it to the source endpoint as an Authorization header, so a feed can import data from an API that requires OAuth 2.0 authentication. It supports the client_credentials and password grant types, and (for client_credentials) can send the client id and secret either in the request body or as an HTTP Basic Authorization header. OAuth settings are stored per feed, not per feed type: the access token URL, grant type, credential placement, scope, and the client id/secret (and username/password for the password grant) are entered on the individual feed edit form. Credential fields use the Key module's key_select element, so each credential references a Key entity that is resolved at request time via the key repository. The module is a thin extension: it does not patch Feeds core and it reuses the core HTTP fetcher's behaviour (caching, conditional If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since requests, timeouts, always-download). Requires the Feeds and Key modules; refresh-token caching is not implemented.
